items.title: There's 'light at the end of the tunnel' for tech stocks amid bond rout: Eric Jackson
items.summary: As bond yields (^TYX, ^TNX, ^FVX) continue to surge ahead, EMJ Capital founder and president Eric Jackson and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre outline the impact this is having on Big Tech stocks and AI hyperscalers.

items.title: AMD and Intel Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after investors reacted to a significant partnership between Google and Marvell Technology for custom AI chip development, signaling a potential shift in market share.

items.title: Tech & Energy Fuel S&P 500 Growth Engine
items.summary: Q2 earnings performance significantly exceeded recent historical baselines, with both growth rates and beat percentages tracking comfortably above 20-quarter averages. Even when excluding hefty contributions from Micron and Alphabet, the overall Q2 earnings picture remained rock-solid.

items.title: Marvell Technology (MRVL) Stock Trades Up, Here Is Why
items.summary: Shares of networking chips designer Marvell Technology (NASDAQ: MRVL) jumped 8.2% in the afternoon session after it disclosed in a company press release, a commercial agreement granting Google parent Alphabet a warrant to buy roughly 7% of its outstanding shares.

items.title: Why Broadcom (AVGO) Stock Is Trading Lower Today
items.summary: Shares of fabless chip and software maker Broadcom (NASDAQ:AVGO) fell 3.9% in the afternoon session after its competitor Marvell Technology landed a deal to develop custom artificial intelligence (AI) chips for Google.
